intro.text: A scribe in the Grand Indicium of Yeddaw, in Tashikk.

items.text: An apprentice of the man Lift calls Darkness had Bidlel's team search the city's records for strange incidents, hoping to find a Surgebinder.

Lift guessed that Darkness's people had made such a search and tried to follow their trail. Tashikki scribes normally keep clients private, but because Lift had Emperor Yanagawn's backing, Ghenna told her about Bidlel. Bidlel had already left ahead of the Everstorm, and as Lift and Wyndle looked for room 232 they ran into Darkness and his followers.
